aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: I am a 4th-year Computer Engineering student and Backend Developer with experience in developing REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot. I have worked on integrating relational databases, authentication with JWT and Spring Security, and generating reports in Excel and PDF. I have also implemented online payments with Mercado Pago, optimized queries with Redis, and deployed applications using Docker. I am passionate about building scalable and efficient solutions, and my goal is to lead a development team, inspiring others to innovate.
